title: 1963 AHSME Problem 19
statement: In counting \(n\) colored balls, some red and some black, it was found that \(49\) of the first \(50\) counted were red. Thereafter, \(7\) out of every \(8\) counted were red. If, in all, \(90\%\) or more of the balls counted were red, the maximum value of \(n\) is:

solutions.text:
The condition is \[49+\frac78(n-50)\geq\frac9{10}n.\] Simplifying gives \(\frac{21}{4}\geq \frac{n}{40},\) so \(n\leq210.\) The maximum is \(210.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: Write the number of red balls as \(49+\frac78(n-50)\)
Require that quantity to be at least \(0.9n\)
